entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF78901. I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 10th. To get started, can you tell me a little more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference issue?

Oh no, it's not broken. It's just... we had an emergency right after it arrived. My son... he was supposed to go on deployment, but he had a sudden medical issue. We've been at the hospital for a week straight dealing with an unexpected surgery. It's been a nightmare.
I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope he's recovering well. Please don't worry about the return. Let me just check the policy for you here.
Thank you. With all the medical bills, I really needed this money back. I was worried I'd missed the window.

Okay, I've got it right here. Actually, you have nothing to worry about. I see it was delivered on January 10th, and our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. You are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Oh, 10 days? Really? That's... that's such a relief! I thought it was much shorter. Thank you so much, Charlie.

It's absolutely my pleasure to help, Sarah. I'm processing the return for you now. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the hour. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I'd like to add a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for your trouble. I hope this helps a little during a difficult time.
You would do that? That is so kind. You've really made my day. Thank you again.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your son a speedy recovery.
